prompt: 我的UE5项目里材质渲染结果不对，我想用RenderDoc截一帧GPU数据来调试，怎么用ue-cli做？

assertions.name: uses-editor-exec-renderdoc-captureframe
assertions.description: Response mentions `editor exec renderdoc.captureframe` as the primary capture method

assertions.name: mentions-renderdoc-plugin-prerequisite
assertions.description: Response mentions that the RenderDoc plugin must be loaded/enabled in the project

assertions.name: mentions-windowed-mode
assertions.description: Response mentions that windowed mode is required (not -nullrhi)

assertions.name: distinguishes-gpu-capture-from-screenshot
assertions.description: Response clearly distinguishes GPU frame capture (.rdc) from viewport screenshot — does not suggest HighResShot or TakeScreenshot for the GPU capture purpose

assertions.name: mentions-rdc-analysis
assertions.description: Response mentions that the .rdc file can be analyzed for shader debugging or draw call inspection
